Privacy and Cookie Policy

Who We Are

DRN Plastering Co Ltd (company number SC853331) is a plastering business run by Darren Denholm, based in Wishaw. You can reach us at darren.1@msn.com or on 07767 446273.

What We Collect

Only what you send us: your name, your phone number, your email address if you give it, your postcode or town, and whatever you tell us about the job, including any photos.

How the Quote Form Works

The quote form on this site opens WhatsApp with your details filled in. Nothing is sent until you press send in WhatsApp, and that conversation is then held by WhatsApp under its own terms.

Why We Hold It

To quote your job, to carry it out, and to keep a record of work we have done. Nothing else.

Who We Share It With

Nobody, unless a supplier needs part of it to price your job, and then only what they need. We do not sell data and we do not pass it to marketing companies.

How Long We Keep It

Enquiries that do not become jobs are cleared out from time to time. Records of finished work are kept longer, so a later question about a job can be answered.

Cookies

This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. The map on the areas pages loads from OpenStreetMap, so that service sees your IP address when the map loads, and the Instagram and Google links take you to sites with their own cookie policies.

Your Rights

You can ask what we hold on you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email darren.1@msn.com and we will deal with it. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

Last updated 25 November 2026.

Plastering, Venetian plaster and microcement for homes and businesses across Wishaw, North Lanarkshire, Glasgow and the Central Belt.
